Native acceptance Run wf_cc097b47-ec5 complete: cc-sync/native-acceptance @ d3512be81244. The live evidence matrix is unchanged: 5 PASS, and cross-config-root NOT COVERED (user-login gate, recorded above).
Astra review found 5 real issues, all fixed:
- BLOCKER (sessionrestore apply.go, pre-existing): a rollback that crashed before cleanup lost data on the next Recover (reproduced at 10/12 fast-forward and 6/12 Replace crash points). Rollback is now the exact inverse of commit (move To back into staging, then restore Backup only when To is absent), restartable from any point, with the crash matrix covering fast-forward and DivergenceReplace.
- BLOCKER (apply.go): a failed rollback deleted staging, including the journal and the only backup. journal.abort now keeps staging and the journal whenever rollback fails, on the Recover and both Apply error paths, with an injectable rename in tests.
- Harness rigor:
  - restores are serialized with per-restore staging ownership checks (no parallel false failures);
  - relocation assertions require at least one source occurrence and an exact mapped-value set equality for persistedOutputPath/planFilePath (no zero-iteration passes);
  - the cross-config-root case refuses a destination config root that resolves to the source's (no false coverage).
Phase 2a merged an earlier native-acceptance head; phase 2b merges d3512be into cc-sync/integration.
